subject: Quick sync: timing preferences for SmartFin pilot?
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Hernandez <sofia@smartfin.co>, Carlos Mendez <carlos.m@smartfin.co>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-20T10:15:00-08:00
Subject: Quick sync: timing preferences for SmartFin pilot?

Hi Sofia / Carlos,

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciated the candid discussion about your fraud-detection backlog and the latency/cost sensitivity on peak days. Quick recap from our end and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Summary (what I heard)
- Goal: Reduce false positives and speed up anomaly scoring during end-of-day batch and peak real-time windows.
- Target latency: 50–80ms p90 for scoring path; acceptable trade for batch inference overnight.
- Data constraints: No PII in model inputs; will use hashed IDs and VPC peering for the pilot.
- Success metrics: 10–15% reduction in false positives on holdout, and stable p90 latency under load.

Proposed pilot scope (4 weeks)
1) Week 0: Technical kickoff + network setup (VPC peering, test buckets).
2) Week 1–2: Model onboarding + quantization run; test harness against sample traffic.
3) Week 3: Shadow/parallel scoring and metric collection.
4) Week 4: Evaluation & go/no-go review.

Requested next steps
- Can we block 30 minutes to review the attached pilot outline and the estimate? I’ve attached the SOW-style outline and a preliminary pricing table.
- Please confirm who on your side will own infra (you mentioned Carlos for network; if anything changes copy him on the kickoff calendar invite).

Proposed times (PST):
- Thu Jan 21, 11:00–11:30
- Mon Jan 25, 09:00–09:30

If those don’t work, say the best week and I’ll send an invite.

Attachments: redwood-pilot-outline-SmartFin-20270120.pdf, pricing-estimate-SF-v1.xlsx

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra

Hi Sofia / Carlos —

Wanted to follow up — we haven’t locked a kickoff and I know priorities move fast. To make it really low-friction, two options:

Option A (fast): 30-minute kickoff this week to review network checklist and pilot timeline; we’ll provision an isolated test environment and walk through sample payloads.
Option B (defer): We put the SOW and a small sandbox on hold and re-open the pilot once you have a confirmed window. No commitment either way.

If you’re still evaluating internally, could you share which quarter you’d prefer we target (Q1/Q2/Q3)? If it helps, Monica can jump on a call to clarify the infra steps — copying her for scheduling.

Proposed quick slots (PST):
- Wed Feb 3, 2:00–2:30 PM
- Thu Feb 4, 9:00–9:30 AM

If I don’t hear back by next Thursday I’ll circle back with one final check-in.

Thanks,
Rishi

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-02-11T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick sync: timing preferences for SmartFin pilot? — last outreach

Hi Sofia —

I don’t want to flood your inbox. Quick last outreach to see if the SmartFin pilot is still on your roadmap this quarter. We’re fully prepared on our side and can move as quickly as you like on the technical kickoff, but I completely understand if priorities shifted.

If you’re still interested, two simple asks:
- Reply with a preferred quarter (Q1/Q2/Q3) or a week window and I’ll book the kickoff.
- Or reply “pause” and I’ll mark the deal as paused and we’ll follow up in ~90 days.

If I don’t hear back, I’ll assume you want to pause and will archive the record to keep our pipeline tidy — happy to re-open whenever you’re ready.

No pressure either way — thanks again for the time so far.

Best,
Rishi
